name: FBM Sphere Tracing with BVH Acceleration
aliases: High-level view algorithm of how step size is computed during the FBM loop
definition: A sphere tracing method for rendering isosurfaces defined by Fractal Brownian Motion (FBM) noise. It uses a BVH to compute valid Sphere Distance Bounds (SDB) and adaptive step sizes, supporting features like Adaptive Lipschitz, Sub-stepping, Early Stop+k, and Quadratic Taylor inclusion functions.
summary: FBM Sphere Tracing with BVH Acceleration speeds up volume rendering by using a procedural hierarchy to compute adaptive step sizes and early termination, reducing evaluation cost from O(N) to O(k).
